signatures.description: Implement a deterministic Calvin-style transaction scheduler in Go: a lock manager grants read/write locks over a batch, records the resulting grant order as a retrospection token, and every replica replays transactions in that recorded order so execution never re-locks and never diverges. Handle cycle-closing deadlock avoidance by aborting the lowest-priority waiter whose grant would close a wait-for cycle (with full rollback of its partial writes), read-to-write lock upgrades that retain their position in the retrospection order, and idempotent replay after a partial batch failure. Deliver production-quality Go code plus table-driven tests proving cycle abort, upgrade ordering, and byte-identical replay across two replicas.
